findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present at the back triple sink. Discussed with PIC, triple sink will be serviced by a licensed plumber. Ensure staff is monitoring facility at a frequency that prevents leaks from occuring.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no CL test strips to be available within facility. Discussed with PIC, CL test strips will be purchased. Ensure facility has the correct test strips available during  all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.116 Warewashing Equipment, Determining Chemical Sanitizer Concentration. Concentration of the SANITIZING solution shall be accurately determined by using a test kit or other device.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be tested at 300 ppm Cl. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bottle was remade and tested at 100 ppm Cl. Ensure all sanitizer solutions are prepared at the proper sanitation levels during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).
